title: Victoria Sponge
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Grease and line two 20cm sandwich tins.
Beat butter and sugar until pale, then beat in eggs one at a time and vanilla.
Fold in flour, divide between tins and bake 22–25 minutes until springy.
Cool completely, whip cream and sandwich cakes with jam and cream. Refrigerate if not serving promptly.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line two 20cm tins.
Whisk dry ingredients, then eggs, milk and oil. Carefully stir in hot water.
Divide into tins and bake 30–35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool.
Heat cream until steaming, pour over chopped chocolate, stir smooth and cool until spreadable. Sandwich and cover cakes.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Lemon Drizzle Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 2lb loaf tin.
Cream butter and caster sugar; beat in eggs and fold in flour and zest of one lemon.
Bake 40–45 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Mix juice of both lemons with granulated sugar. Pierce warm cake and spoon drizzle over. Cool in tin.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Carrot Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm round tin.
Whisk eggs, oil and sugar; fold in flour, baking powder, cinnamon, carrots and walnuts.
Bake 35–40 minutes until centre is set. Cool completely.
Beat cream cheese with icing sugar and spread over cake. Keep chilled.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Coffee and Walnut Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line two 20cm tins. Dissolve coffee in water and cool.
Cream first butter and sugar; beat in eggs, flour, half the coffee and walnuts.
Divide and bake 25–30 minutes. Cool fully.
Beat remaining butter with icing sugar and remaining coffee; sandwich and ice.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 2lb loaf tin.
Mash bananas and mix with melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour and cinnamon without overmixing.
Bake 50–55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Marble Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 2lb loaf tin.
Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs and fold in flour and vanilla.
Divide batter; stir cocoa and milk into one half. Alternate spoonfuls in tin and swirl once.
Bake 45–50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Orange Polenta Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm round tin.
Cream butter and sugar; beat in eggs and orange zest.
Fold in almonds, polenta and baking powder. Spoon into tin.
Bake 40–45 minutes until set; spoon over juice from one orange while warm.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Apple Crumble Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm square tin.
Cream 100g butter with caster sugar; beat in eggs and fold in self-raising flour and milk.
Spread batter in tin and cover with thin apple slices.
Rub remaining butter into plain flour, brown sugar and cinnamon. Scatter on top and bake 45–50 minutes.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Gingerbread Loaf
steps: Heat oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Line a 2lb loaf tin.
Warm butter, sugar and treacle gently until melted; cool slightly.
Mix flour, ginger and bicarbonate. Stir in treacle mixture, milk and egg.
Bake 50–55 minutes until set. Cool before slicing.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line two baking trays.
Cream butter and sugars, beat in egg, then fold in flour, bicarbonate and chocolate.
Scoop 18 spaced mounds onto trays.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges are golden. Leave on trays 5 minutes before moving.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Shortbread Fingers
steps: Heat oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Line a 20cm square tin.
Cream butter and sugar, then work in flour until a soft dough forms.
Press into tin, prick with a fork and score into fingers.
Bake 22–25 minutes until pale gold. Cut while warm and cool fully.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Oat and Raisin Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line trays.
Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg. Mix in flour, oats, raisins, cinnamon and bicarbonate.
Spoon spaced portions onto trays.
Bake 12–14 minutes until edges set; cool on trays briefly.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Ginger Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line baking trays.
Melt butter with syrup gently. Mix flour, sugar, ginger and bicarbonate.
Combine wet and dry ingredients; roll small balls and space on trays.
Bake 10–12 minutes until golden; cool to crisp.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Jam Thumbprint Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line trays.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in yolk, then work in flour.
Roll into 20 balls, make a thumb indentation in each and add a little jam.
Bake 12–15 minutes until lightly golden. Cool before eating; jam is very hot.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line trays.
Beat peanut butter, butter and sugar; add egg, flour and baking powder.
Shape into 16 balls and flatten with a fork.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges set. Cool on tray.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Coconut Macaroons
steps: Heat oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Line a tray.
Whisk egg whites lightly until foamy, not stiff. Stir in sugar, coconut and vanilla.
Form 16 mounds with damp hands.
Bake 15–18 minutes until golden and set. Cool fully.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Double Chocolate Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line trays.
Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg. Fold in flour, cocoa, bicarbonate and chocolate.
Scoop 16 spaced portions.
Bake 10–12 minutes. Centres will firm as they cool.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Lemon Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line trays.
Cream butter and sugar with lemon zest; add yolk and flour.
Roll dough into small balls and flatten gently.
Bake 10–12 minutes until lightly golden. Cool.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Almond Biscotti
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line tray.
Mix flour, sugar and baking powder; add eggs, vanilla and almonds to make firm dough.
Shape two logs and bake 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.
Slice diagonally and bake slices 7–8 minutes per side until dry and crisp.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Basic White Bread
steps: Mix flour, yeast and salt (keep salt and yeast apart initially), then add water and oil.
Knead 10 minutes until elastic. Cover and prove 1–2 hours until doubled.
Shape into loaf, place in greased 2lb tin and prove 40–60 minutes.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25–30 minutes until golden and hollow-sounding. Cool on rack.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Wholemeal Bread
steps: Mix flours, yeast and salt; add water and oil to form dough.
Knead 10–12 minutes; prove covered until doubled.
Shape into loaf tin and prove until risen just above rim.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30–35 minutes. Cool fully.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Easy Bread Rolls
steps: Mix ingredients to make dough; knead 10 minutes.
Prove covered until doubled, about 1 hour.
Divide into eight balls, place on tray and prove 35–45 minutes.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 18–20 minutes until golden.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Focaccia
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, water and 30ml oil to a sticky dough; knead or fold until smooth.
Prove in oiled bowl until doubled, then tip into well-oiled 23x33cm tray.
Rest 30–45 minutes, dimple with fingers, drizzle remaining oil and add rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 20–25 minutes until golden. Cool.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Garlic Flatbreads
steps: Mix flour and yoghurt into a soft dough; knead briefly.
Divide into six, roll thinly and cook in a dry hot frying pan 2–3 minutes per side until cooked through.
Melt butter with crushed garlic gently; brush over cooked breads and sprinkle parsley.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Cheese Scones
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line tray.
Rub butter into flour and mustard powder. Stir in cheese and enough milk for soft dough.
Pat to 2cm thick; cut eight rounds without twisting cutter.
Bake 15–18 minutes until risen and golden.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Fruit Scones
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line tray.
Rub butter into flour, stir in sugar and sultanas, then milk to make soft dough.
Pat to 2cm thick, cut eight rounds and brush tops with beaten egg.
Bake 12–15 minutes until risen and golden.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Plain Scones
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line tray.
Rub butter into flour; stir in sugar and milk to form soft dough.
Pat 2cm thick, cut eight rounds and brush tops with beaten egg.
Bake 12–15 minutes until golden. Serve with jam.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Line 12-hole muffin tin.
Mix flour and sugar in one bowl; whisk eggs, milk and oil in another.
Combine briefly, fold in blueberries and divide into cases.
Bake 20–23 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Chocolate Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Line muffin tin.
Mix flour, cocoa, sugar and chips. Whisk eggs, milk and oil separately.
Combine gently without overmixing; divide into cases.
Bake 18–22 minutes until set.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Banana Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Line muffin tin.
Mash bananas. Whisk eggs, oil and milk, then stir in bananas.
Fold into flour and sugar until just combined.
Divide into cases and bake 18–22 minutes.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Line muffin tin.
Mix flour, sugar, poppy seeds and lemon zest. Whisk eggs, milk, oil and juice of one lemon.
Combine briefly and divide into cases.
Bake 18–22 minutes until risen and set.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Vanilla Cupcakes
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line cupcake tin.
Cream first butter and sugar, beat in eggs and vanilla, fold in flour.
Divide between cases and bake 18–20 minutes. Cool completely.
Beat remaining butter with icing sugar and milk; pipe onto cooled cakes.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Chocolate Cupcakes
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line cupcake tin.
Cream first butter and sugar, beat in eggs, then fold in flour, first cocoa and milk.
Divide and bake 18–20 minutes; cool fully.
Beat remaining butter, icing sugar and remaining cocoa into frosting and pipe on top.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Red Velvet Cupcakes
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line cupcake tin.
Whisk egg, sugar, oil, buttermilk and colouring. Fold in flour and cocoa, then bicarbonate and vinegar.
Divide into cases and bake 18–22 minutes. Cool fully.
Beat cream cheese with icing sugar and spread on cupcakes. Refrigerate.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Mix flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt; add milk, egg and 50g softened butter.
Knead until elastic and prove until doubled, about 1 hour.
Roll into rectangle; spread remaining butter and sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up and cut 12 pieces.
Prove in greased tray 30–45 minutes; bake at 190°C (170°C fan) 22–25 minutes. Drizzle icing sugar mixed with water.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Apple Turnovers
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line tray.
Peel and dice apples; cook gently with sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice for 5–7 minutes. Cool.
Cut pastry into eight squares, spoon cooled filling on each, fold into triangles and seal edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Jam Tarts
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Lightly grease 12-hole shallow bun tin.
Rub butter into flour, add cold water to form pastry; chill 15 minutes.
Roll pastry, cut 12 rounds and line tin. Add a teaspoon of jam to each, not overfilling.
Bake 15–18 minutes until pastry is golden. Cool before eating.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Mini Sausage Rolls
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line tray.
Mix sausage meat with sage. Cut pastry lengthways into two strips.
Shape sausage meat into two logs, wrap in pastry, seal with beaten egg and cut into 16 pieces.
Brush tops with egg and bake 22–25 minutes until golden and sausage meat is fully cooked, piping hot throughout.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Cheese Straws
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line trays.
Sprinkle pastry with cheese and paprika; fold in half and roll gently.
Cut 20 strips, twist and place on trays. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake 12–15 minutes until crisp and golden.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Classic Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm square tin.
Melt chocolate and butter gently; cool slightly. Whisk sugar and eggs, then stir in chocolate mixture.
Fold in flour and cocoa, pour into tin.
Bake 25–30 minutes until top set with a slight wobble in centre. Cool completely before slicing.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Flapjacks
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 20cm square tin.
Melt butter, sugar and syrup gently; stir in oats.
Press mixture firmly into tin.
Bake 20–25 minutes until golden. Score warm and cool fully before lifting.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Millionaire Shortbread
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line 20cm square tin.
Rub first butter into flour and caster sugar; press into tin and bake 20–25 minutes. Cool.
Heat condensed milk, remaining butter and brown sugar in heavy pan, stirring constantly until thick and golden, about 8–10 minutes. Pour over base and cool.
Melt chocolate gently, spread on cooled caramel and chill until set. Cut with warm knife.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Rocky Road
steps: Line a 20cm square tin.
Melt chocolate, butter and syrup gently; cool a few minutes.
Break biscuits into pieces and fold into chocolate with marshmallows and raisins.
Press into tin and refrigerate at least 2 hours until firm. Cut into squares.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: No-Bake Cheesecake
steps: Line base of 20cm springform tin.
Crush biscuits and mix with melted butter; press firmly into base and chill.
Beat cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla. Whip cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Spread on base and refrigerate at least 6 hours until firm. Keep chilled.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Rice Krispie Squares
steps: Line a 20cm square tin.
Melt butter and marshmallows gently in a large pan, stirring until smooth.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in cereal until coated.
Press into tin with lightly buttered spatula; cool and cut.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Chocolate Tiffin
steps: Line a 20cm square tin.
Crush biscuits roughly. Melt butter and syrup gently; stir in cocoa.
Mix biscuits and raisins into cocoa mixture, press firmly into tin.
Melt chocolate and spread on top. Chill 2 hours until firm; slice.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Fruit Crumble
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Put peeled sliced apples and berries in baking dish and sprinkle caster sugar.
Rub butter into flour until crumbly, then mix in brown sugar.
Scatter crumble over fruit without pressing down.
Bake 30–35 minutes until topping golden and fruit bubbling. Rest before serving.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Bread and Butter Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Butter bread and arrange in baking dish with raisins.
Whisk eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla; pour over bread.
Leave to soak 15 minutes.
Bake 35–40 minutes until custard is set with a slight wobble. Serve warm.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.

title: Baked Rice Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Butter a deep ovenproof dish.
Mix rice, milk and sugar in dish. Dot with butter and sprinkle nutmeg.
Bake 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes, until rice tender and top golden.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Contains potential allergens; check ingredient labels. Follow safe handling and storage guidance, especially for eggs, dairy and uncooked fillings.
